stem:
Leo wants to buy some shoes. He found the shoes at three different stores for a price of $35. The stores are each having a sale.

• Store X is offering 15% off the price of the shoes.

• Store Y is offering $5 off the price of the shoes.

• Store Z is offering a \frac{1}{5} discount off the price of the shoes.

Which statement about the sale price of these shoes is true?

options.label: F
options.text: Store X has the best sale price of $20.

options.label: G
options.text: Store Z has the best sale price of $28.

options.label: H
options.text: Store Y has the best sale price of $30.

options.label: J
options.text: Store Z has the best sale price of $7.
